text: Google Antigravity is our agent-first development platform.
You may have tried Antigravity before, but with Gemini 4 Argon,
it's more fun to build than ever.
Let me show you what I mean.
We built this 3D Pagoda model with a multi-agentic looping workflow.
Antigravity coordinated specialized sub-agents through visual critique loops.
Argon autonomously sculpted the architecture and surrounding environments
without manual 3D modeling.
We go from a text prompt to an explorable world in minutes,
from a photo of a desk to a 3D racing game.
With a single prompt, Antigravity orchestrates sub-agents,
uses Blender MCP and NanoBanana to turn everyday objects into a playable game.
We designed a handheld retro game console, end-to-end, in Antigravity.
It generated the parts list, wiring diagrams, enclosure designs, and the AI game engine.
We went from 3D renders to a playable piece of hardware.
Here, we took a basic 2D map set,
and Antigravity converted it to a 3D world running on a Pixel phone.
Argon is rolling out in the Antigravity desktop app, Antigravity CLI,
and by logging into Antigravity in Android Studio.
